purpose: Measure three fixed bounded workloads, distinguish supervised teaching from automatic teacher takeover, and retain all failures. Frozen before the first assistant/SMS model evaluation.

classical_baseline.calibration: LAC scores on the same conformal half used by System 1; no temperature fitting. No test tuning.

takeover.stream_order: Sort teaching and calibration rows together by SHA-256 of workload name, colon, normalized group digest; use at most the first 1000. Stop on promotion.
takeover.promotion: Unchanged default policy: 80% agreement and 80% local acceptance with exact statistical lower bounds, fresh validation blocks and repeated-attempt error budget. Post-takeover independent test targets remain 95% accepted correctness / 80% acceptance.

gemini_settings.output: JSON object containing one enumerated intent label

limits: BANKING77 is a replication of the already published three-intent result. Assistant and SMS are first evaluations for this project.
Assistant task covers six named CLINC150 intents only; no out-of-scope detector claim.
SMS uses normalized-deduplicated historical messages split by a fixed group hash; near-duplicate campaigns can still cross splits.
All thresholds, scope, model settings, and cohorts remain fixed after testing. No promise of universal accuracy, superiority or production readiness follows from a small set of workloads.
